Definition: properly, strength; hence, anything strong; specifically a chief (politically); also a ram (from his strength); a pilaster (as a strong support); an oak or other strong tree
BiblicalUsage: 1) ram; 1a) ram (as food); 1b) ram (as sacrifice); 1c) ram (skin dyed red, for tabernacle); 2) pillar, door post, jambs, pilaster; 3) strong man, leader, chief; 4) mighty tree, terebinth
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
